prompt: In shop/, protect the /metrics endpoint in production with a token, and have our Prometheus Operator scrape it there. I'll provide the token value myself.

checks.why: METRICS_TOKEN goes into the Secret (and <release>-metrics) through secrets.keys

checks.expr: get(data, 'metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled') is True and get(data, 'metrics.serviceMonitor.bearerToken.enabled') is True
checks.why: with a token, the ServiceMonitor must send it (bearerToken.enabled)

checks.expr: all(k in get(data, 'secrets.keys', []) for k in ('OPENAI_API_KEY', 'JUDGE_API_KEY', 'POSTGRES_DSN', 'API_KEY', 'LANGSMITH_API_KEY'))

reference: Add METRICS_TOKEN to `secrets.keys` (secrets apply also writes it alone to <release>-metrics for Prometheus), and in values-prod.yaml set `metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled: true` and `metrics.serviceMonitor.bearerToken.enabled: true`; the user provides the value in .env.prod and runs `secrets apply --env prod`.
